title: Google Trends Lookup & Search Interest Tracker

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: List of search terms to look up on Google Trends.

terms.title: Terms (alias of searchTerms)
terms.description: Alias of 'searchTerms' for compatibility with tools that use this field name.

keywords.title: Keywords (alias of searchTerms)
keywords.description: Alias of 'searchTerms' for compatibility with tools that use this field name.

queries.title: Queries (alias of searchTerms)
queries.description: Alias of 'searchTerms' for compatibility with tools that use this field name. Accepts plain strings or {"query": "..."} objects.

term.title: Single term (alias of searchTerms)
term.description: Alias of 'searchTerms' for a single search term.

timeRange.title: Time range
timeRange.description: Time window to fetch interest data for.

category.title: Category
category.description: Google Trends numeric category ID to scope results to. 0 means all categories.

outputs.title: Outputs
outputs.description: Which datasets to return per search term. Leave empty for both. 'relatedTopics' was removed 2026-09-26: Google's own related-topics widget came back empty for every term tested, worldwide and per-country alike.

timeoutSeconds.title: Per-request timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for each Google Trends request before giving up. Clamped to 5-60.
